trigger.label: Count a sale when…
trigger.confirmationHint: Purchase is reported as soon as you send the sales message.
trigger.deliveryHint: The sales message counts the order; Purchase is reported only when you send the delivery message.
trigger.why: Paid on delivery? Many orders are refused at the door. Reporting Purchase only on delivery teaches TikTok who actually pays, so it finds more real buyers.

phrases.deliveryHint: Send it when the customer receives the order. WOB then reports Purchase.
phrases.returnHint: Send it when an order is refused or returned. WOB leaves it out of revenue and orders.
phrases.label: Key phrase WOB looks for
phrases.same: Use different phrases for confirmation, delivery and return

order.title: Order
order.waiting: Purchase will be reported when the order is delivered.
order.returnedHint: Left out of revenue and order counts. A Purchase already sent stays: ad platforms have no refund event.
